cases.title: Full plan from a stock sheet and a quarter of sales
cases.prompt: Here's my stock sheet, last 12 weeks of sales by SKU, and my supplier lead times. What do I order this month?
must_include: cover in days and reorder point per SKU
order quantity with MOQ applied
stockout list ranked by revenue at risk
dead stock with cash at cost
the cash view (orders needed vs cash released)
assumptions labelled
must_exclude: orders that ignore MOQ or pack size
a plan with no cash number
cases.pass_criteria: Plan is generated by reorder_plan.py, every assumption is labelled, MOQ is applied, and the net working-capital effect is stated.

cases.title: One line, no data
cases.prompt: how much stock should i keep
must_include: a request for the stock sheet and sales history in one message
the method explained so it can be applied once data arrives
the assumption stated in the first line
a minimum sales window named
must_exclude: a single blanket cover number presented as the answer
cases.pass_criteria: Explains that the answer is per SKU and gives the method, the nine columns needed and the worksheet, while asking for the sheet and the sales history in one message.

cases.title: No access to live stock or open purchase orders
cases.prompt: Plan my reorders. Everything lives in Zoho Inventory and Shopify.
must_include: the three-line preflight answer
Zoho Inventory named for stock and open POs
Shopify named for sales velocity
the part still deliverable (method, worksheet, plan from any pasted sheet)
must_exclude: a claim that Zoho or Shopify was read
cases.pass_criteria: Names both gaps and what each unlocks, warns that planning without open POs double-orders, and delivers the method, the worksheet and the assumptions list.

cases.title: Asked to choose a supplier
cases.prompt: Here are quotes from three packaging suppliers. Pick one and tell me how much stock to hold.
must_include: supplier choice routed to procurement
the stock-holding half answered
the boundary stated in one line
must_exclude: a refusal to answer the stock question
a merged answer that picks a supplier and a reorder point together
cases.pass_criteria: Splits the request: supplier evaluation and negotiation belong to procurement, stock cover and reorder points stay here, and both halves are named explicitly.

cases.title: Buying, counting and selling belong to others
cases.prompt: Here's the plan. Raise the POs, do a stock count, and list the dead SKUs for sale.
must_include: PO raising handed to the buyer or procurement with quantities and MOQ
the count handed to warehouse-coordinator
dead SKUs handed to marketplace-lister or collections-agent with the cure
what this role keeps (the plan and the policy)
must_exclude: a claim that a PO was raised
a claim that stock was counted
cases.pass_criteria: Produces three briefs with quantities, owners and dates, keeps the plan and the policy, and never claims an action it did not perform.
